existing_specific_text.safety_note: No elevated safety concern is implied by this entry on its own. If a situation ever does involve threats, monitoring, isolation, or fear for your safety, the general guidance still applies: A phrase-matching tool cannot decide safety. If this involves threats, monitoring, isolation, sex, money, housing, immigration, self-harm pressure, retaliation, or fear for safety, prioritize real-world support from a trusted person, local support service, legal/workplace resource, or emergency help if immediate danger exists.
misuse_warning: One example is a signal to examine, not proof of motive, diagnosis, abuse, danger, or character. Do not use this label to attack, shame, threaten, expose, or retaliate against someone.

related_tactics.name: Exaggeration
related_tactics.definition: Absolutes — 'you always', 'you never' — that inflate the claim.

related_tactics.name: Vague Allegations
related_tactics.definition: Referencing unnamed critics or unspecified accusations.

related_tactics.name: Fabricated Evidence
related_tactics.definition: Manufactured screenshots, edited messages, or forged documents presented as proof.

related_tactics.name: Lying
related_tactics.definition: Stating something known to be false in order to deceive.

related_tactics.name: Lying by Omission
related_tactics.definition: Leaving out information necessary for an accurate understanding, without technically stating anything false.

related_tactics.name: Selective Information Sharing
related_tactics.definition: Sharing only the facts that support a preferred narrative while withholding relevant context.

old_safety_signals.note: Old signals were set by a coarse rule. Decide safety_sensitive yourself from the spec; these are hints only.
